name: My Heart's Flame
source:
Akabi has been taking care of herself and her ill mother ever since Akabi's father died when she was little. Now that Akabi has recently transferred to Avalon High School, she's working harder than ever. Strange things are occurring. Will Akabi be able to overcome the challenges ahead and find love? Or will she be overwhelmed?

[Edited from [url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=43&t=25184]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
translation:
自从父亲在赤比年幼时去世，她一直独自照料自己和生病的母亲。如今，赤比刚转入Avalon高中，比以往更加努力。奇怪的事情接连发生。赤比能否克服前方的挑战并找到爱情？还是会被一切压垮？

[改编自[url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=43&t=25184]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
